items.title: Alarm — Wake immediately
items.desc: Zero negotiation. The alarm is a command, not a suggestion. Feet on cold floor activates cortisol awakening response. No snooze. Ever. 3:30 AM is decided at 8:45 PM the night before.

items.title: Wake gratitude - thank the universe
items.desc: On waking, before the feet hit the floor: thank the universe for this life, thank everyone, and thank all five elements - earth, water, fire, air, ether.

items.title: Tongue scraper (copper)
items.desc: Removes Ama (toxins). 30 seconds. Before any water or food enters the mouth. Ayurvedic morning detox.

items.title: Oil pull (coconut oil)
items.desc: Start swishing immediately before any water. Standing in bathroom. Mouth completely dry. Pulls bacteria, whitens teeth, strengthens gums. 3-4 min.

items.title: Cold water dive reflex
items.desc: While still swishing oil. Vagus nerve activated. Full wakefulness. Resets nervous system. BIOHACK.

items.title: Spit oil pull + rinse
items.desc: Spit into trash, not sink. Rinse mouth with warm water. Oil pulling complete — bacteria removed, gums strengthened.

items.title: Brush teeth
items.desc: After oil pull, not before. Brush thoroughly. Clean slate before fenugreek water enters the system.

items.title: Fenugreek water (soaked overnight)
items.desc: Soak 1 tsp methi overnight in copper vessel. Copper ionises water, kills bacteria, thyroid support. Total 250ml.

items.title: Collagen 15g + amla (vit C)
items.desc: MOVED from 4:27 — evidence window is 30-60 min BEFORE tendon loading (Shaw & Baar 2017), so peak aminoacidemia lands on the run/gym. Amla = the ~50mg vitamin C co-factor (lemon squeeze is only ~15mg). Verify dose is 15g.

items.title: Pre-run hydration — 500-750ml + pinch of salt
items.desc: You train after an 8h overnight fast in Indian humidity. ~400-500mg sodium (pinch of salt, nimbu optional). Cheapest performance + clarity fix in the protocol. ACSM fluid replacement.

items.title: Marma point self-massage
items.desc: Vagbhata. Ajna 30s, Hridaya 30s, Nabhi 30s clockwise. 2 min. Full body energy activated. Pressure points.

items.title: Pranayama (Nadi Shodhana)
items.desc: Nadi Shodhana or Kapalabhati. Open air rooftop. Phone away. 5 min compressed. SACRED.

items.title: Japa (108 beads)
items.desc: Mala or silent. Phone away. Full presence. Do not suppress. Pure witnessing. Japa = concentration. This = equanimity.

items.title: Thai forest meditation
items.desc: Sit still after Japa. Close eyes. A sound arises — note: sound. A thought — thinking. A sensation — sensation. Do not follow. Do not suppress. 3 min open awareness.

items.title: Ho'oponopono prayer (morning)
items.desc: I love you. I'm sorry. Please forgive me. Thank you. Morning forgiveness - clear resentment before the day begins.

items.title: Earthing — bare feet on ground (SUNDAY ONLY)
items.desc: SUNDAY ONLY — not possible on weekdays. Eyes open to sky. 3 things spoken aloud. Step onto grass or earth. Bare skin contact. Morning gratitude is an opening, not a review.

items.title: Coffee + L-theanine — phone-free
items.desc: MOVED from 8:05 — the caffeine curve now rises INTO Study 1 and still fuels the 6:00 session. ONLY caffeine of the day (curfew 2 PM; the 3:30 slot is decaf). L-theanine 100-200mg = the studied calm-focus combo.

items.title: STUDY 1+2 — 90 min: INTERVIEW PREP + CODING
items.desc: Mission ②: interview preparation & coding — the hardest material gets the deepest block. Phone in another room, no electronics. WEDNESDAY: 40 min only, long run rolls 5:00.

items.title: Oats bowl (pre-train fuel)
items.desc: Small bowl before swim/run/gym. SUNDAY tri-day variant: short swim, then oats jar + banana in the car to the outskirts — long ride + brick run, 60g carbs/h on the bike. WEDNESDAY: bowl at 4:45 before the 5:00 long run.

items.title: Creatine 5g (daily — rest days too)
items.desc: Timing is irrelevant, DAILY saturation is everything — vegetarians have 20-30% lower stores and get the largest strength + cognition response (2024 meta-analyses). Never skip on rest days. L-carnitine moved to the 7:05 post-workout meal — fasted with water it never reaches muscle (needs carbs/insulin, Wall 2011 J Physiol).

items.title: Hard-day fuel — 2-3 dates / 1 banana
items.desc: On interval / brick / long (>90 min) days — fasted stays only for easy Zone-2 ≤90 min (fasted training buys zero performance; IOC RED-S 2023). NEVER skip before punishment rides: 30-100km must always be fueled, 30-60g carbs/h during.

items.title: Ikigai spoken aloud
items.desc: I am not trying to win. I am refusing to stop. Said with conviction. Every single morning.

items.title: 2-min visualization - see the day executed
items.desc: Two minutes, eyes closed. Vividly rehearse the day going exactly as planned - the run, the work, the wins. Mental rehearsal primes the nervous system. Every single morning.

items.title: Sattu drink
items.desc: 100g Sattu + 350ml water + half lemon + pinch of salt. Takes under a minute. Drink steadily while driving.

items.title: Box breathing (4-4-4-4)
items.desc: Alert neutrality. Engine on, car stationary. 5 rounds. Then go. Navy SEAL protocol.

items.title: RUN — We LONG 5:00 AM · Tu easy 4:15 PM · Su brick
items.desc: ONE long run per week: WEDNESDAY 5:00-7:00 AM (until Nov, then it swaps to Sunday and the ride shrinks). Tuesday 4:15 PM easy 40-50 min after market close — ends at the 5:30 recovery dinner. Sunday: brick 5-10k off the bike (15-21k version 1x/month max). Easy = 7:00-7:30/km, HR cap 145.

items.title: SWIM — daily except Wednesday
items.desc: IN THE WATER AT 6:00 SHARP — scooty out the door 5:55. Skill sport: daily frequency, zero injury cost. Mon = easy recovery. Main sets Tue/Thu. Sat easy before the tempo ride. Sun short opener before the long ride + brick. Home ~7:00.

items.title: Post-workout meal FIRST (whey + carbs) + L-carnitine
items.desc: SELF-SERVE — never wait for the cook (he arrives 7:00-7:30, unpredictable): whey shake + yesterday-prepped poha/overnight oats from the fridge. Cook cooks LUNCH + tomorrow-morning prep, not breakfast. EAT BEFORE HOT SHOWER. 30-40g protein (whey/paneer — feeding 1 of 4, ~0.4g/kg each) + fast carbs within 20-30 min = anabolic window, doubly real after FASTED training (ISSN). Take L-carnitine HERE with the carbs — muscle uptake is insulin-dependent (Wall 2011). Hot shower after eating = vasodilation delivers nutrients.

items.title: Hot shower (38-42°C, 10 min)
items.desc: AFTER cool-down + meal. 38-42°C for 10 min. Vasodilation: blood vessels expand, nutrients delivered to worked muscles. Growth hormone mild pulse. Cortisol drops. Does NOT suppress mTOR (unlike cold after gym). Science: Scandinavian J Medicine 2024.

items.title: Calf + soleus micro-dose — 15 min (We AM + Tu PM)
items.desc: After the Wednesday long run (morning) and the Tuesday evening run, at home: heavy single-leg calf raises straight-knee + bent-knee (soleus) + hip stability. The soleus absorbs 6-8x bodyweight per stride — the #1 marathon-injury insurance. Non-negotiable through the entire run ramp.

items.title: STUDY 2 — 60 min: STOCK MARKET (Tu/Th/Fr: GYM instead)
items.desc: Mon/Wed/Sat: study 7:50-8:50. GYM ×3 — TUE lower body + calves · THU upper + core · FRI full-body LIGHT (never heavy legs before the weekend rides). Scooty, after breakfast; on gym days study slides to 3:05 post-market. Race-taper weeks: gym drops to 1×.

items.title: Chyawanprash (1 tsp)
items.desc: MOVED from 3:38 AM — 1 tsp is ~6-8g sugar; taken pre-dawn it broke the overnight fast before the entire training block. With breakfast the amla/immunity case stays, the fast stays intact.

items.title: Oats + paneer breakfast
items.desc: Post-gym meal at 7:05 already covers nutrition. This is removed from daily tracking.

items.title: Vitamins (D3+K2, algal Omega-3 ≥1g, B12)
items.desc: B12 250-500µg ADDED — 68-77% of unsupplemented lacto-vegetarians are functionally low; the single biggest vegetarian gap. Omega-3: verify label delivers ≥1000mg EPA+DHA (most veg caps are 200-300mg — switch to algal). D3 with a fat-containing meal is correct. Blood panel every 6 months: B12+MMA, ferritin, 25(OH)D, HbA1c, testosterone, T3, LFT.

items.title: CDP-Choline
items.desc: Not required daily — disabled from routine tracking. Re-enable manually on days of use.

items.title: Fruit break — jamun / pomegranate / berries
items.desc: Daily anthocyanin serving (≥50-100g) — memory + executive-function RCTs; rotate jamun (season), pomegranate, black grapes, frozen blueberries, fresh amla.

items.title: Review time blocks for the day
STUDY 3 — moved to 3:05 PM (market opens 9:00)
items.desc: MOVED post-market — see midday. Market 9:00-3:00 owns this slot now.

items.title: MARKET OPEN — at the desk 9:00-3:00
items.desc: Stock market hours, at the computer, untouchable. Deep-work discipline applies: phone away, no mid-session training thoughts. Lunch 1:30 at the desk (dabba).

items.title: 1-hour deep study - NO electronics on
items.desc: SUPERSEDED by STUDY 1+2+3 blocks — off daily tracking. One focused hour of study/learning with zero electronic devices switched on. Book, notes, pen. Single subject, pure input. Compounds over months.

items.title: Lunch dabba ready — desk lunch at 1:30
items.desc: Cook arrives 7:00-7:30 (never exact — doesn't matter): SMART-LOCK CODE + entrance/kitchen CAMERA = he lets himself in, every entry logged, footage = accountability. You're usually home anyway (till 11:15). MENU CARD on the fridge decides what he cooks — never him. Dabba ready by ~9:30. Door closed for Study 2/3 — the card answers every question.

items.title: Desk ready — market prep (office days: leave ~8:20)
items.desc: At the computer by 9:00 sharp, market hours 9:00-3:00. Evening chain unchanged: whatever the day held, night prep 7:30 → lights out 8:45 (Fri/Sat 8:30).

items.title: Posture reset + desk ergonomics
items.desc: Spine straight, shoulders back, monitor at eye level. 30 sec body scan. Prevent tech neck and lower back compression.

items.title: 20-20-20 eye rule
items.desc: Every 20 minutes look at something 20 feet away for 20 seconds. Do a full 2-minute eye rest — palming, blinking, distance gaze.

items.title: Hydration check (750ml by noon)
items.desc: Track water intake. Minimum 3L per day target. Copper vessel preferred. Room temperature or warm.

items.title: Standing stretch (5 min)
items.desc: Neck rolls, shoulder shrugs, hip flexor stretch, hamstring stretch. Counter the damage of sitting. Every joint.

items.title: Box breathing (2 min)
items.desc: 4-4-4-4 pattern. Resets cortisol after morning deep work blocks. Parasympathetic activation before lunch.

items.title: Lunch — salad+dal FIRST, paneer/dahi, roti LAST
items.desc: EXACTLY 1:30 PM (time fixed — was listed 2:00 after the 1:50 post-lunch walk). EAT ORDER: salad + dal/paneer first, roti/rice last — cuts the glucose spike ~30-40% = no 2-4 PM fog. Millet (ragi/jowar/bajra) or brown rice > white rice. Paneer or dahi = protein feeding 2 of 4. No phone. Chew 32×.

items.title: Shata Pada (100 steps after lunch)
items.desc: Walk 100 steps after every meal. Vagbhata prescription. Aids digestion, prevents insulin spikes. Non-negotiable.

items.title: Warm water (copper vessel)
items.desc: Sip warm water 15-20 min after lunch. Never cold water with meals — kills Agni. Ayurvedic digestive fire protection.

items.title: STUDY 3 — 40 min: MARKET REVIEW / flex (Tue: run 4:15 after)
items.desc: Post-market sitting: day review + either mission → 2h30 study daily. On gym days this carries the market-study slot. Tuesday: easy run 4:15-5:15 PM after this, ending at the 5:30 recovery dinner.

items.title: DECAF green tea + L-Theanine
items.desc: CAFFEINE CURFEW 2 PM — caffeine needs ~8.8h clearance before bed (Sleep Med Rev 2023 meta-analysis) and lights-out is 8:45. L-Theanine 200mg alone keeps the calm-focus effect; decaf keeps the ritual. Keep all tea ≥1h away from meals — tannins cut iron absorption 60-90% (vegetarian-critical).

items.title: Handful of soaked almonds/walnuts
items.desc: Brain fuel. Soaked overnight for better absorption. 8-10 almonds + 3 walnuts. Omega-3 for afternoon cognitive performance.

items.title: Afternoon sunlight (5 min)
items.desc: Huberman protocol — late afternoon sun viewing helps set circadian clock for proper melatonin onset. No sunglasses. Direct exposure.

items.title: Micro-gratitude (1 thing)
items.desc: Pause. One specific thing from today. Say it internally. Resets hedonic adaptation. Afternoon anchor point.

items.title: End-of-work task review
items.desc: Review deep work blocks completed. Flag unfinished items for tomorrow. Capture loose threads before shutdown.

items.title: Inbox zero pass
items.desc: Process remaining messages. Reply, delegate, or defer. Clean digital workspace before evening covenant begins.

items.title: Shutdown ritual — "Shutdown complete"
items.desc: Cal Newport shutdown ritual. Review calendar for tomorrow. Say "Shutdown complete" out loud. Work brain OFF. Evening brain ON.

items.title: 5 PM top-up — sattu shake / fruit + PB + 2 kiwis
items.desc: MANDATORY on big days (We long run, Sat ride, Sun tri-day, Tue run), optional otherwise. SATURDAY = DOUBLE (sattu 5:00 AND fruit/poha before 6) — Saturday is the highest-carb day; Sunday's tri-day is fueled today. Lunch is the day's biggest meal (tell the cook: athlete portion); this is the last food before the cutoff. Night = milk + paneer only — the 30g casein pre-sleep dose. 2 kiwis: RCT −35% sleep latency. Blanch any sprouts.

items.title: Laptop close — HARD STOP
items.desc: Work ends — OUT of the office by 6:45-7:00 sharp, no "just 5 more minutes". Home ~7:15. The 8:45 lights-out is decided here, at the office door, not at home.

items.title: PHONE OFF → hall drawer (lives in the HALL, travels nowhere; ON 9:00)
items.desc: TERRITORY RULE (phone-rituals/ rulebook): phone lives in the hall drawer or the car DASH MOUNT (nav only) — never rooms/hand/pocket. ONE touch: 6:40-6:55 PM (log day + SYNC Strava/HAE + OTPs + cook menu) + answered calls. Emergency use = in the CAR only (never inside house/office). Watch eSIM = the world's door. Breach price: 10km walk (touch) / 30km (left hall) / 50km (feed) — daytime, flat, no compounding. Evening rituals tick on PAPER; 9:05 catch-up.

items.title: Sprout mix (moong/chana)
items.desc: Last food of the day. 1.5h before sleep. Light meal = stomach clear by 8:30 PM. Empty stomach sleep = full recovery mode. Growth hormone maximised. Evening Covenant begins.

items.title: Tomorrow planning (time blocks)
items.desc: Write tomorrow's plan NOW so 3:30 AM wake has zero decision-making. Pre-decide everything.

items.title: Fill copper vessel + soak methi + oats
Kit packed — tomorrow's sport
items.desc: Tomorrow's kit every evening. SATURDAY EVE: bottles mixed + fridged, bike INTO the car, tires + chain checked, oats jar packed — Sunday = tri day (swim → long ride → brick). Zero morning decisions.

items.title: Cold water dive reflex
items.desc: MOVED TO MORNING (post-run) - evening cold raises arousal and fights the magnesium + glycine sleep stack. Kept in the list, off daily tracking.

items.title: Nasya oil (2 drops per nostril)
items.desc: Lubricates brain pathway. Improves sleep quality. Every night. 30 days = visible difference.

items.title: Mula Bandha practice
items.desc: Root lock. Engage 10s, release, 10 reps. Ayurvedic energy conservation. Upward movement of Ojas.

items.title: Shilajit (ICP-MS COA-verified ONLY)
items.desc: ONLY with a batch-specific heavy-metals certificate (Pb/As/Cd/Hg/Tl, independent lab, <1yr old) — 2024-25 testing found lead and thallium in "purified" resins; the word has no legal meaning. No COA = skip entirely (creatine + ashwagandha already cover its claimed benefits with better evidence). Max ONE dose/day. Warm water, alone.

items.title: Magnesium glycinate + Glycine + Triphala (cycled)
items.desc: Magnesium GLYCINATE only (oxide barely absorbs), ≤350mg elemental + Glycine 3g (RCT: lowers core temp, faster sleep onset). Triphala now CYCLED — 3 wk on / 1 wk off (chronic daily use risks laxative dependency + CYP450 interactions). All in warm water.

items.title: Milk + paneer + Ashwagandha — night closed
items.desc: 400-500ml + turmeric + black pepper + Ashwagandha 300-600mg ROOT extract only (India banned leaf in supplements, Apr 2026 — check label) + Jatamansi + 2 tbsp cottage cheese. CYCLE 8-12 wk on / 2-4 wk off; stop all herbals + get LFTs if dark urine/itching/jaundice (rare hepatotoxicity, LiverTox grade C). Casein overnight = muscle repair.

items.title: All electronics on charge - OUTSIDE bedroom
items.desc: Every device (phone, watch, laptop) plugged in to charge OUTSIDE the bedroom. Bedroom is a no-device zone - removes the 3:30 AM temptation and the +10 km bedroom-device penalty.

items.title: Roman Examen (review of conscience)
items.desc: 3 min written. What aligned. What did not. What changes tomorrow. Final line: Tomorrow I will improve [one specific micro-thing] by 1%. Kaizen. 1% daily = 37x better in one year.

items.title: 3 Wins of the day
items.desc: 3 wins written + "This happened because..." Internal locus of control. Harvard: strongest longevity predictor.

items.title: Trataka (candle gazing)
items.desc: Fixed gaze on flame. 5 min. Sharpens concentration, improves eyesight, calms mind. SACRED.

items.title: Ho’oponopono prayer
items.desc: 4 phrases directed at anyone with mild irritation: I love you. I’m sorry. Please forgive me. Thank you. Held resentment = chronic cortisol = accelerated aging. 3 min Hawaiian forgiveness.

items.title: Evening oral care - brush + interdental
items.desc: Two-minute fluoride brushing + interdental cleaning (floss or interdental brush). Last thing before bed. Overnight clean teeth prevent decay and gum disease.

items.title: LIGHTS OUT
items.desc: 3:30 AM is decided here. 8:45 PM → 3:30 AM = ~6h45m sleep (evidence-corrected up from 6h). The morning is won or lost in the first 60 seconds of this moment. FRI + SAT NIGHTS: lights out 8:30 — 7h before the weekend sessions (Sat tempo ride, Sun tri day).
